title: ClimateSoilBundle
description: Input bundle sent from orchestrator to physics_worker and optimizer_worker. Contains parcel metadata, soil properties, 90-day climate arrays, and NDVI time-series.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, west negative. Querétaro reference: -100.3899

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Querétaro reference: 20.5888

source.description: Data provenance: 'live' = fetched from API now, 'cache' = from local cache file, 'preset' = synthetic demonstration bundle

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when data was fetched or generated (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)

synthetic.description: True if data is synthetically generated for demonstration purposes (must be true when source='preset')

clay_pct.description: Clay content in % (0-100). From SoilGrids: clay_raw_value / 10. Thickness-weighted mean over 0-30cm.

sand_pct.description: Sand content in % (0-100). From SoilGrids: sand_raw_value / 10. Thickness-weighted mean over 0-30cm.

silt_pct.description: Silt content in % (0-100). Computed as max(0, 100 - clay_pct - sand_pct). Thickness-weighted mean over 0-30cm.

soil_ph.description: Soil pH in water (pH units, 0-14). From SoilGrids: phh2o_raw_value / 10.

soc_g_kg.description: Soil organic carbon in g/kg. From SoilGrids: soc_raw_value / 10.

nitrogen_g_kg.description: Total nitrogen in g/kg. From SoilGrids: nitrogen_raw_value / 100.

field_capacity_mm.description: Volumetric water content at field capacity in mm, over root zone Z_r=600mm (Saxton-Rawls pedotransfer). Invariant: wilting_point_mm < critical_water_mm < field_capacity_mm.

wilting_point_mm.description: Volumetric water content at permanent wilting point in mm, over root zone Z_r=600mm (Saxton-Rawls pedotransfer). Invariant: wilting_point_mm < critical_water_mm < field_capacity_mm.

critical_water_mm.description: Critical soil water threshold in mm = wilting_point_mm + p * (field_capacity_mm - wilting_point_mm), where p=depletion_p from crops_catalog.json. Invariant: wilting_point_mm < critical_water_mm < field_capacity_mm.

usda_texture_class.description: USDA texture class derived from clay/sand/silt triangle (e.g. 'SiltLoam', 'ClayLoam', 'SandyLoam', 'SiltyClay').

depth_aggregation_rule.description: Depth aggregation method used: thickness-weighted mean of 0-5cm (weight=5/30), 5-15cm (weight=10/30), 15-30cm (weight=15/30).

dates.description: Daily dates in YYYY-MM-DD format. Length determines array sizes for all climate variables.

t2m_max_c.description: Daily maximum 2m air temperature in °C. null indicates -999 fill value from NASA POWER (gap to be filled by M1 splines).

t2m_min_c.description: Daily minimum 2m air temperature in °C. null indicates -999 fill value from NASA POWER.

rh2m_pct.description: Relative humidity at 2m in % (0-100). From NASA POWER RH2M. null indicates gap.

rs_mj_m2_day.description: Downwelling solar radiation in MJ/m²/day. From NASA POWER ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN. If POWER returns kWh/m²/day, multiply by 3.6 to convert.

ps_kpa.description: Surface pressure in kPa (≥0). From NASA POWER PS.

u2_m_s.description: Wind speed at 2m height in m/s (≥0). Prefer WS2M from NASA POWER. Use u10×0.748 only if WS2M unavailable.

precip_mm.description: Precipitation in mm/day (≥0). From NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR.

et0_mm.description: Reference evapotranspiration in mm/day (≥0). Computed by orchestrator via FAO-56 Penman-Monteith. null only if required inputs are missing.

gwetroot.description: Root zone soil wetness fraction (0-1) from NASA POWER GWETROOT. Used for W(0) calibration in Open-Meteo fallback.

soil_moisture_vol.description: Volumetric soil moisture in m³/m³ (0-1, NOT percent). From Open-Meteo soil_moisture_0_to_1cm or SMAP. W(0) = soil_moisture_vol[0] * Z_r where Z_r=600mm.

dates.description: 16-day composite acquisition dates in YYYY-MM-DD (MOD13A2 cadence from AppEEARS/GIBS).

ndvi.description: NDVI values in range -1 to 1. null = cloud-contaminated gap; Module 1 (natural cubic spline TDMA) fills nulls before Modules 2-4.

qa_cloud_mask.description: QA cloud mask flag from MOD13A2 (0=clear, 1=cloud/gap). Aligns with ndvi array.

crop_id.description: Active crop ID referencing crops_catalog.json (e.g. 'maize'). Used for W(0) calibration via depletion_p and for GDD t_base lookup.

horizon_years.description: Planning horizon in years for MILP optimizer. T = horizon_years × 2 cycles/year.
